Thomas De Quincey, Confessions of an English Opium-Eater.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/thomas-de-quincey/confessions-of-an-english-opium-eater

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Thomas De Quincey (annotator, author, writer of preface), died 1859.

First publication of the text used (SE colophon: 'Confessions of an English Opium-Eater was published in 1821 by Thomas De Quincey.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published before 1931 (SE colophon: 'Confessions of an English Opium-Eater was published in 1821 by Thomas De Quincey.'), so it is in the United States public domain. The edition's rights statement below says the same.
- Country of origin: does not matter, because every person whose words are in the text died in 1925 or earlier. The text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less. The last person to die died in 1859.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook.
